Metadata.description: Tools and resources for communities to build and sustain mutual aid networks.

banner.title: This is what community looks like
banner.subtitle: Communalists gives mutual aid networks the tools to organize, share and take care of each other.
banner.imageAlt: A volunteer hands a plate of hot food to a neighbor at a community meal

about.title: Built for mutual aid
about.body: Communalists is a free platform where neighbors organize. Start an organization for your mutual aid group, tool library or community club, find groups near you, and run them with tools made for how mutual aid actually works.
about.languages: Available in English, Español, Tiếng Việt and 中文.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.body: Start a group or join one near you. Every organization gets its own public page.

requests.title: Requests
requests.body: Take requests through a public form and track each one on a shared board until it's fulfilled.

library.title: Library
library.body: Lend tools and supplies within your group, and always know who has what.

planning.title: Calendars and documents
planning.body: Plan events and shifts, and keep your group's knowledge in one place.

Home.earlyDays: Communalists is in early development. Create an account now, and new tools will appear as they're ready.

join.title: Ready to organize?
join.body: It's free, and it only takes a minute.

Unclaimed.title: This page hasn't been claimed yet
Unclaimed.body: Communalists volunteers added {name} so neighbors can find help nearby. {name} doesn't run this page, so details may be out of date. Check with them before you go.
Unclaimed.claim: Is this your organization? Claim it
Unclaimed.claimHint: You need a free account. Our team checks every request.
Unclaimed.adminBody: Nobody has claimed this organization yet, so every super user can edit it. You aren't shown as its owner.

Claim.title: Claim {name}
Claim.intro: If you're part of {name}, you can take over this page, or ask us to take it down.
Claim.step1: Tell us your role and how we can confirm it's you.
Claim.step2: Someone on the Communalists team checks, usually by contacting the organization directly.
Claim.step3: If it checks out, you become the owner of the page (or we take it down). Come back here to see where your request stands.

claim.label: Manage this page
claim.description: You become its owner: you can edit it, and people can ask to join.

remove.label: Take this page down
remove.description: The page and its listing are removed. Choose this if you don't want to be listed.

Claim.roleHint: For example: pastor, volunteer coordinator, office staff.
Claim.message: How can we confirm it's you?
Claim.messageHint: For example: "Call the church office and ask for me", or a link to a page that lists you. 10 to 1,000 characters.
Claim.privacy: Only the Communalists team sees your request, along with your name and your account email. We use them only to check it, and we may email you about it.

errors.messageTooShort: Tell us a little more: at least {min} characters.

formErrors.notUnclaimed: This organization has already been claimed or taken down.
formErrors.alreadyPending: You already have a request waiting for this organization.

Claim.pendingClaim: You asked to manage {name} on {date}. The Communalists team will check it and may email you. Come back here to see if it has been decided.
Claim.pendingRemove: You asked us to take down the page for {name} on {date}. The Communalists team will check it and may email you. Come back here to see if it has been decided.
Claim.denied: We couldn't confirm your last request. You can send a new one with more detail on how to check.

Admin.title: Super user tools
Admin.intro: Requests to claim or take down unclaimed organizations, and the organizations added for neighbors to find. Only super users see this page.
Admin.claimsHint: Check each request outside the app before you approve it, for example by calling the organization at its public number. Oldest first.

claim.title: Make {name} the owner of {org}?
claim.body: {name} becomes the owner and can edit the page and approve members. The page stops saying it's unclaimed, and super users can't edit it anymore. Any other requests for {org} are closed.

remove.title: Take down {org}?
remove.body: The page and its listing disappear for everyone. The address stays reserved. Any other requests for {org} are closed.
